dimensions.relevance: 0 unknown, 1 adjacent service, 2 exact publicly described service match
dimensions.need: 0 speculation only, 1 evidenced possible opportunity, 2 explicit public request for technology or partners
dimensions.decisionMaker: 0 unknown, 1 relevant public role/contact, 2 named public decision-maker with matching role
dimensions.budget: 0 unknown, 1 documented funding or paid project, 2 explicit suitable budget; never infer from company size
dimensions.timing: 0 unknown, 1 dated recent initiative, 2 explicit current deadline or hiring/partner request
dimensions.delivery: 0 unconfirmed, 2 founder confirms ability to deliver the specific recommended service

notes: Each non-delivery score needs an exact verified source quote. AI suggestions need Score Reviewed=true before qualification. A draft also needs Contact Verified and Outreach Approved.
